title: OpenStax says toddlers point to pictures in books
summary: OpenStax Psychology says toddlers, defined there as 12 to 24 months, point to pictures in books and look in the right place when asked to find something.
body: The lifespan chapter says that because toddlers have object permanence they enjoy hide and seek, and that they also point to pictures in books and look in appropriate places when asked to find objects. The page defines toddlers as 12 to 24 months old. The pointing line is a textbook summary, not a measured percent and not the CDC item about looking at a few pages together at 18 months. Object permanence itself is a separate claim. This card is only the social pointing at book pictures.
